name: Prismatic Piper, Clara Oswald, Faceless One — the chosen color when it is its owner's commander, whoever controls it
notes: Conor, 2026-10-14: these cards are the color their owner chose if the card is the owner's commander. 'If The Prismatic Piper is your commander, choose a color before the game begins. The Prismatic Piper is the chosen color.' The 'your commander' condition (cards-parser.js CONDITION_PARSERS) is now Battlefield.isCommander alone, which reads the owner's command zone; for a while it also required the source's controller to own it, so a stolen Piper lost its color. Player 2's commanders are The Prismatic Piper (chose red) and Clara Oswald (chose blue); Player 1 takes the Piper with Control Magic and it stays red; Clara is blue (read from Player 1's tab). Player 1's Faceless One (chose green) is not Player 1's commander and stays colorless. Memory: project_commander_identity_by_owner_2026-10-14.
